# PDF/A-1b validation {#sec-pdfa .appendix}

## Final deposit on theses.fr

The French national thesis repository [theses.fr](https://theses.fr) requires a
PDF/A-1b file (ISO 19005-1). The PDF produced by this template is designed to meet
the criteria used by CINES — the body responsible for institutional archiving of
French doctoral theses.

## Official validator: facile.cines.fr {short-title="Official validator"}

**[facile.cines.fr](https://facile.cines.fr)** (CINES) is the reference validator
for deposit on theses.fr. It — not third-party tools — determines whether your PDF
will be accepted. Simply upload the PDF to obtain an immediate report.

## Automated check from the post-render script

The post-render script can query the CINES web service automatically.
Simply set `validate: true` in `_quarto-en.yml`:

```yaml
# In _quarto-en.yml — before depositing to theses.fr:
validate: true
```

Then render as usual:

```bash
quarto render --profile en --to cnam-thesis-pdf
```

The script sends the PDF to the CINES web service and displays the result:

```
Validating PDF/A on facile.cines.fr (CINES)...
[OK]  PDF/A-1b valide -- archivable sur theses.fr.
```

If the PDF fails:

```
[!!]  PDF/A-1b non valide.
      -> Corriger via : https://facile.cines.fr/#correction
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## After validation

Set `validate: false` back in `_quarto-en.yml` for day-to-day builds —
the web service call is only needed before the final deposit.
:::

## If validation fails

Use the official correction service:
**[facile.cines.fr/#correction](https://facile.cines.fr/#correction)**.
It automatically corrects the most common non-conformities
with no additional software to install.
